definitions.explanation: A person who has completed their studies and graduated from a school, university, or other educational institution.

examples.japanese: {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}を{代表|だいひょう}して{挨拶|あいさつ}した。
examples.english: I gave a speech as the representative of the graduates.

examples.japanese: この{大学|だいがく}の{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}は{各分野|かくぶんや}で{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: Graduates of this university are active in various fields.

examples.japanese: {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}が{母校|ぼこう}に{集|あつ}まって{同窓会|どうそうかい}を{開|ひら}き、{懐|なつ}かしい{思|おも}い{出|で}を{語|かた}り{合|あ}った。
examples.english: Graduates gathered at their alma mater for a reunion and shared fond memories.

notes:
USAGE:
{卒業生|そつぎょうせい} is a compound of {卒業|そつぎょう} (graduation) and {生|せい} (student/person). It refers to someone who has already graduated, in contrast to {在校生|ざいこうせい} (current students).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}{代表|だいひょう} (representative of the graduating class)
- {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}{一同|いちどう} (all graduates)
- {有名|ゆうめい}な{卒業生|そつぎょうせい} (famous alumni)
- {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}を{送|おく}り{出|だ}す (to send off graduates)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {卒業生|そつぎょうせい}: graduate, alumnus (general)
- OB/OG: old boy / old girl (informal Japanese abbreviations for alumni)
- {同窓生|どうそうせい}: fellow alumni (emphasizes shared school connection)
